teaser: Woodsmoke hangs low over a campsite long after the others have gone quiet in their tents, and you are still awake, chair pulled back from the fire, watching the embers fall apart. Life path 7 and the INTJ letters meet here without much fuss: both already prefer the edge of a circle to the middle of one. What is particular to this crossing is how little persuading it takes. The number asks for solitude to think things through; the type was built to think alone and call it efficient. Put the two in one person and the quiet stops needing an excuse.
